config.title: Run identity — the requested/effective contract every result refers to
config.description: One complete, credential-free run identity: the exact request (profile, tag or generated legacy projection, plus role overrides) AND the complete effective stack — provider, suite-normalized base, model, inference controls, prompt and response-schema revisions, effective tool manifest, the one singleton embedding identity, policy/ranker component references, the effective budget and rate-card provenance. `identityId` is canonical SHA-256 over the identity's own payload excluding the id field; no clock, observation, usage, latency, key, secret or cache identifier is ever part of that payload. Reports and stores carry these in the `identityEnvelope` shape defined here: a table of identities and rows that either reference one (`run`), state that they are analysis that never ran a stack (`not-run`), or state that their facts were never recorded (`legacy-unrecorded`) — an absence is a stated absence, never a fabricated identity. Every object closes its properties, so a credential-shaped member cannot be carried.

embedding.description: The one embedding identity of the run, or null when the stack resolved no embedding component (a legacy request whose configured wire was never proven by this run's work). A profile request always resolves one.

issueCode.description: Stable machine refusal/validation codes. TCFG1001 unknown capability tag; TCFG1002 unknown parent; TCFG1003 inheritance cycle; TCFG1004 duplicate id; TCFG1005 unresolvable reference; TCFG1006 role/candidate kind mismatch; TCFG1007 invalid document; TCFG1008 unavailable credential slot; TCFG1009 provider/model unavailable on host; TCFG1010 required feature unavailable; TCFG1011 missing required tool; TCFG1012 embedding identity disagreement; TCFG1013 credential-bearing URL; TCFG1014 secret-shaped member; TCFG1015 no available candidate for tag; TCFG1016 profile attempts to raise a host ceiling; TCFG1017 component unavailable at revision; TCFG1018 row references no identity; TCFG1019 registry revision mismatch; TCFG1020 invalid role override; TCFG1021 incomplete wire request.

credentialSlotStatus.description: Slot presence only. `source` names WHERE a value would come from (an environment variable name, `settings`), never the value.

hostManifest.description: The credential-free host facts pure resolution consumes. Endpoints are suite-normalized bases; models/features are declared or probed; `observation` dates a LIVE refresh and stays null for synthetic/keyless manifests, which must be clock-free.

tools.description: The compiled toolbox manifest — `createToolbox().list()` with each input schema's canonical revision.

roleOverride.description: What a request may override per role — never a credential slot, host availability or a permission.

legacyWireState.description: The generated projection of pre-profile desktop/environment settings for ONE wire. `unconfigured` is the only state eligible for built-in/grounded fallback; `incomplete` names what was requested and resolves to an issue, never to a silent substitute. `configured-unproven` records a wire that was configured but whose width no work of this run ever observed: the stack claims NO embedding identity rather than guessing one.

profileRequest.description: Exactly what was asked for: a named profile, a capability tag, or the generated legacy projection of pre-profile settings.

components.description: The component references the host product genuinely runs for a legacy request — the shipped policy pipeline and ranker — recorded by the adapter that generated the projection, never guessed.

chatPrompt.description: The versioned chat template the legacy host actually uses, as a content revision; null when no chat surface exists.

toolManifest.description: Requested set and the effective intersection with the host allowlist. A missing required tool refuses before an identity exists, so an identity's manifest never carries one.

effectiveRole.description: Everything that role actually runs with — the values, not the intent that selected them.

effectiveEmbedding.description: The one embedding identity of the run — every corpus and query vector in the run uses it. Dims are the registry value CONFIRMED against a probe/reply, never guessed from a model label.

identityEnvelope.description: The identity table plus the rows that refer to it — the shape every identity-bearing report and store carries. The `$query` assertions bind at validation time: identity ids are unique, row ids are unique, and every `run` row resolves to exactly one identity in the table.

resolution.description: The pure resolver's only two outcomes. Refusal is a value: sorted stable issues with document paths, no secret in any detail.

rowIdentityRef.description: How a result row refers to the identity table. `run` rows name an identity that exists; `not-run` rows are analytic (a ceiling, a census) and cannot pretend to a provider; `legacy-unrecorded` rows keep historic results whose stack was never captured — honest absence, never a backfilled guess.

lightRagGroundedAnswer.$comment: Derived from https://tangleai.dev/schemas/grounding-answer in @tangleai/documents/grounding. Regenerate; the shared module is the only answer-contract owner.

id.description: A reply-local claim id, unique within this answer.

text.description: One factual proposition, complete on its own.

citations.description: The evidence ids this claim was read from — only ids listed in the prompt.

reason.description: Why the supplied evidence cannot answer the question.
